shortDescription: Automatic time tracking for your PC. Missing Hours records what you work on and shows your day as a timeline. Free, and everything stays on your computer.
description:
Do you still remember on Friday what you worked on on Tuesday? Missing Hours does. Missing Hours automatically records which programs and windows you use and when you are away from your computer. It turns this into a clear timeline for every day, so you can review your working hours and write invoices without starting a stopwatch.

• Starts with Windows and records quietly while you work
• Detects breaks and absence automatically
• Daily timeline with your programs' icons
• Light and dark theme
• Privacy first: no cloud, no account, no telemetry. Your data never leaves your computer.
• Free: no subscription, no ads, no in-app purchases
